text:
What if your soul woke up inside a cat… and the only person who could return your body was a spirit guide who absolutely hates humans? Been building a cinematic anime project inspired by Makoto Shinkai visuals using GPT Image + Seedance on
@yapper_so 

Every frame is AI-generated and stitched into one connected story universe.  Rainy spirit cities Giant celestial worlds Ghost trains & floating lanterns Emotional fantasy journey between life and death  

Title: “Soul Transfer” 
Act 1 is finally complete.  

Tools used: 
• GPT Image 
• Seedance 2.0 
• Suno for soundtrack 
• Edited frame-by-frame for cinematic continuity on capcut and add subtitle, sfx

This is probably the most ambitious AI anime project I’ve made so far.   

#AIFilm #Anime #MakotoShinkai #AIGenerated #Seedance #GPTImage #SunoAI #Cinematic #AnimeArt #AIAnimation #WorldBuilding #FantasyAnime #IndieAnimation #ViralVideo #AIArt #Yapper
content:
Generate every frame as an AI image (e.g., with GPT Image) and stitch the frames into a single connected story sequence for a consistent story universe.  
Edit frame-by-frame in CapCut to maintain cinematic continuity, then add subtitles and SFX in the same pass.

Genera cada fotograma como una imagen de IA (por ejemplo, con GPT Image) y une los fotogramas en una secuencia de historia conectada para un universo de historia consistente.  
Edita fotograma por fotograma en CapCut para mantener la continuidad cinematográfica, luego añade subtítulos y efectos de sonido en el mismo paso.
